baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives to worship Allah, guard oneself with respect to Him, and obey the first-person speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence assigns the object of worship, establishes a protective posture toward that object, and then makes the addressee tractable to the speaker's command. The final human-directed obedience serves the God-directed allegiance rather than competing with it.

activation_trace.role: Worship with submissive obedience supplies the primary allegiance and the first movement of the sequence.
The worshipped one fixes Allah as the allegiance's object rather than another human authority.
Placing the self in protective caution supplies the guarded middle posture.
Pliant yielding turns the posture into responsive execution through the speaker.

changed_reading.before: Three adjacent religious commands: worship, fear, and obey.
changed_reading.after: One ordered allegiance mechanism: orient service to Allah, place the self under protective caution, then enact that allegiance by yielding to the speaker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical branches of worship, guarding, and obedience within the three imperatives.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material-action analogy joins a surface made passable, a barrier that wards harm, and practical capacity. The verse can therefore describe preparation for reliable action, not bare demand alone.

activation_trace.role: Physical subduing and smoothing supplies the image of making a route or medium passable.
A protective barrier supplies the guardrail that keeps passage from becoming exposure.
Practical capacity supplies the ability to carry the prepared action through.

changed_reading.before: The hearers are simply ordered to comply.
changed_reading.after: The hearers are called into a prepared mode of action: make the way traversable, retain protection, and become practically able to proceed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from worshipping Allah through self-guarding to responsive agreement with the speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: Magnification, protective caution, and responsive agreement form a social-affective mechanism: what is given ultimate weight reorganizes what the self guards and with whom it can move in agreement.

activation_trace.role: Honoring and magnifying supplies the reallocation of ultimate weight.
The worshipped one locates that magnification exclusively in Allah.
Self-protective caution converts honor into a regulated inward stance.
Agreement and responsive following make the inward stance socially operative.

changed_reading.before: Worship is ritual duty and obedience is external compliance.
changed_reading.after: The verse reallocates honor so that guarded inward alignment can become responsive agreement with the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sending, warning that awakens caution, and disclosure by speech recast the final imperative as reception of an authorized relay. Obedience to the speaker is the delivery path of the God-directed command, while the warning explains why protective caution occupies the middle position.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one reserves ultimate allegiance for Allah and constrains the relay model.
Protective caution is the response that the warning is meant to awaken.
Pliant obedience is the hearer's completion of the transmission chain.
Messenger and message supply delegated transmission rather than independent human sovereignty.
A warning that frightens and awakens caution links the relay to the focus ayah's protective middle command.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign makes obedience answer disclosed content rather than opaque personality.

structural_cues: The focus names Allah as the object of worship but attaches the first-person object only to the command to obey.
The two preceding ayat identify the speaker as sent and as a clear warner before the three imperatives arrive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: delegated message, caution-awakening warning, and clear disclosure. Reader: authority flows from Allah through the messenger to the hearer's action. Alternative: the context may establish office without implying a detailed relay mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Obey me can sound like a second, personal claim beside worshipping Allah.
changed_reading.after: Obey me is the terminal link of a disclosed warning sent from Allah; it operationalizes rather than rivals worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context differentiates coverings. Forgiveness covers fault while preserving its bearer from the fault's effect; the resistant hearers cover themselves against the call; truth-covering seals that refusal. The focus command to place oneself in protection is therefore not generic withdrawal but selection of a receptive, God-facing cover rather than insulation from warning.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm with a barrier supplies the focus ayah's open question of what kind of protection is sought.
Pliant reception distinguishes protective caution from defensive closure.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the reparative form of cover.
A cover laid over a thing supplies deliberate insulation from the warning.
Garment and covering make the resistant counter-protection bodily and visible.
Concealing truth names the terminal epistemic form of covering against the message.

structural_cues: Forgiveness is the first stated consequence after the focus triad, while bodily self-covering appears in the repeated refusal scene.
The focus places protective caution before obedience, so protection is tested by whether hearing remains possible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: reparative covering, bodily covering, and truth-concealment. Reader: these are rival protective strategies, with obedience marking permeability to warning. Alternative: the cover images may be independent descriptions with no deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Guard yourselves from Him means fear or avoid punishment in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Place yourselves under the right cover: the protection that repairs and keeps warning audible, not the self-covering that blocks hearing and becomes truth-concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory allows obedience to include working oneself into ability. Context images of created readiness, successive stages, state after state, and human growth turn compliance from an assumed instant capacity into a cultivated process whose stages are already patterned in creation.

activation_trace.role: Working oneself into ability anchors obedience as acquired capacity rather than effortless assent.
Practical capacity supplies the state toward which that effort develops.
Fitness and readiness supply a created affordance for becoming able to answer.
Successive stages supply the temporal architecture of cultivated response.
One state after another reinforces ordered transition rather than a single leap.
Human growth and upbringing give the staged capacity model an organic developmental image.

structural_cues: The focus triad itself can be read progressively: orient allegiance, establish caution, then enact responsive capacity.
Ayat 71:14-17 move through stages, layered creation, and human growth in sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: readiness, stages, successive states, and human growth. Reader: the same pattern scaffolds moral ability to obey. Alternative: the creation sequence may prove divine power without modeling ethical development.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is a binary act the hearer is presumed already able to perform.
changed_reading.after: Obedience includes entering a created process of becoming able, state by state, until willing response is practicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch pictures smoothing or subduing a traversable surface; the later context spreads the earth and supplies penetration along extended roads through wide passes. Protective caution functions as a guardrail and practical capacity as actual traversal, producing a route-engineering reading of the triad.

activation_trace.role: Physical smoothing and subduing supply the focus-side image of making passage possible.
A harm-warding barrier supplies the route's protective boundary.
Practical capacity converts prepared terrain into traversed terrain.
Earth as a spread carpet supplies the broad prepared surface.
Penetrating along a road supplies realized movement through the prepared medium.
An extended road meant to be traversed gives the movement a durable channel.
A wide open mountain pass supplies room for collective passage rather than a constricted escape.

structural_cues: The purpose construction in 71:19-20 joins the spread earth to the act of traversing its routes.
The three coordinated focus imperatives can function as preparation, protection, and movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a smoothed focus branch plus spread surface, traversal, roads, and passes. Reader: the material route is an analogy for enacted allegiance. Alternative: the context may describe physical provision only, leaving the focus branch materially unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The triad regulates inward belief and outward deference without a spatial mechanism.
changed_reading.after: The triad prepares a way of life as traversable infrastructure: level allegiance, retain a guardrail, and move through the opened route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later report pairs departure from obedience with following an alternate social lead, then voices commands to retain worshipped figures and ends in loss of direction. The focus triad is therefore a transfer of followership: exclusive worship fixes the ultimate object, caution resists the rival command network, and obeying the messenger redirects collective motion.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the allegiance that rival followership contests.
Pliant obedience supplies the authorized direction of collective following.
Things treated as worshipped objects expose the competing allegiance named by the opponents' command.
Exiting obedience supplies the direct reversal of the focus ayah's final imperative.
Allegiance and serial following show that refusal is not autonomy but transfer into another chain.
The named worshipped idol concretizes the object around which the rival chain is organized.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the rival chain's trajectory.

structural_cues: Ayah 71:21 directly contrasts they disobeyed me with they followed, making the two verbs competing directions rather than obedience versus independence.
The opponents' imperatives in 71:23 preserve their worshipped objects and counter the imperatives of 71:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: disobedience, alternate following, rival worshipped objects, and directional loss. Reader: the focus is a deliberate transfer between command networks. Alternative: the later report may diagnose consequences without forming a structural counter-triad.

changed_reading.after: Obey me contests an already organized followership: no one stands outside allegiance, so the issue is which object, command, and trajectory structure the group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing concern links the servants who can be misdirected with generation that produces further rupture. Read back into the plural imperatives, worship-protection-obedience becomes an intervention in a self-reproducing social pattern, not only a set of private acts.

activation_trace.role: Worship and submissive obedience anchor the intervention in the focus ayah's collective summons.
Protective separation supplies the interruption that could prevent transmission of the destructive pattern.
Something produced from something else supplies generation as a reproducing mechanism, while retaining the literal birth context.
Servanthood and submissive worship identify the people whose allegiance the reproduced pattern redirects.
Deviation from right and tearing a cover supply the destructive character attributed to what the cycle produces.

structural_cues: The focus addresses a plural audience, so its response can alter collective continuity as well as individual conduct.
Ayah 71:27 places misleading the servants and producing a deviant successor in one forecast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: servants are misdirected and birth produces further rupture. Reader: literal generation also images social reproduction, and the focus triad interrupts that loop. Alternative: the birth statement may concern offspring only, with no cultural-transmission arrow.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks currently living individuals to reform their own conduct.
changed_reading.after: The verse intervenes in a collective pattern that manufactures its next iteration; guarded allegiance and responsive obedience can break transmission across generations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ط ع target for the focus root ط و ع, a form-distant mapping represented by only one mapped occurrence. It remains anchored to the focus token and is reinforced by the context's light and lamp images, but downstream prose must call it a sound-neighbor or split-map resonance, never the lexical sense or etymology of obey.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus token أطيعون through its packet-supplied non-dominant mapping from ط و ع to س ط ع.

activation_trace.role: Rising or spreading through the air supplies the exploratory image of a command becoming a broadcast signal.
Illumination supplies a visible medium through which the raised signal can orient response.
The luminous lamp supplies a concrete source for the signal image.

changed_reading.before: Obey me concerns downward submission to a speaker's command.
changed_reading.after: As a strictly exploratory split-map resonance, obey me also evokes receiving an orienting signal that rises and spreads like light from a lamp.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because it links the focus barrier to later scenes of engulfment, entry, absent aid, shelter, and trust. It remains anchored in the protective-barrier branch of واتقوه, but downstream prose must present it as an enclosure analogy and must not identify Noah's house with an ark, guaranteed salvation, or the opposite interior of the fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protective-barrier branch of واتقوه in the middle of the focus triad.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that wards harm anchors the search for a protective interior.
Drowning in water supplies the surrounding destructive medium against which an interior would protect.
Going into an inside supplies involuntary entry into a destructive enclosure.
Going into an inside also supplies voluntary entry associated with the prayer's household boundary.
Aid that makes one prevail is explicitly absent, removing external rescue from the spatial mechanism.
Shelter and dwelling supply the bounded hospitable interior.
Heart-rest in security and trust supplies the inward quality associated with entry into shelter.

changed_reading.before: Protective caution is an internal emotion directed toward God.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, protective caution is choosing a trustworthy interior before engulfment leaves only forced entry and no outside aid.

strongest_changes: The speaker's obedience claim became an authorized transmission relay rather than a second object of allegiance.
Protective caution became a choice among rival coverings: reparative cover, receptive guard, or defensive truth-concealment.
Obedience became cultivable capacity patterned through readiness, stages, successive states, and growth.
The focus triad became a counter-network that redirects existing social followership and can interrupt its reproduction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's terse three-command surface opened into several mechanisms without requiring one final interpretation: relay, covering, development, route preparation, social allegiance, and generational transmission. The packet's material branches made protection and obedience operational rather than merely attitudinal.
remaining_uncertainties: The route and growth mechanisms may be contextual analogies rather than deliberate semantic extensions of the focus commands.
The generational model depends on allowing literal birth to support, without replacing, an inference about social reproduction.
The س ط ع signal outlier is authorized only by the packet's non-dominant split mapping and must remain explicitly form-distant.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A three-stage protective program.** **ع ب د B003** supplies worship and submissive obedience, **ء ل ه B001** the worshipped one, **و ق ي B002** self-guarding caution, and **ط و ع B001** pliant, willing compliance. The three coordinated imperatives move from exclusive orientation, to protective restraint, to responsive action. The packet supplies the sequence; the abductive arrow is that worship establishes allegiance, caution blocks destructive conduct, and obedience carries the warning into practice. The ayah reads as an ordered mechanism of rescue rather than three interchangeable pieties.

2. **Willing pliancy opposes hardened self-enclosure.** **ط و ع B001** contributes tractable yielding and **B003** practical capacity. The later response in 71:7 combines physical blocking, persistent resolve, and magnified pride, while 71:21 names disobedience and following. The inferred contrast is that capacity to respond exists but is made inwardly unavailable by rigidity. “Obey me” therefore reads as a call to become workable and receptive, directly reversing the bodily and social mechanics of refusal.

3. **Worship also reassigns honor.** **ع ب د B006** carries honoring and magnifying, beside **ع ب د B003** worship; 71:13 asks why they do not assign God due weight, and 71:23 shows them preserving other deities. The packet supplies worship, absent weight, and rival objects; the abductive move is that worship functions as a transfer of magnification to its proper object. The ayah gains an honor-order reading without losing its ritual and obedient sense.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:21 corrected any notion that refusal meant independence: disobedience was immediately followed by another allegiance. 71:23 further revealed the rival objects, confirming that the three commands concern the placement of service, protection, and compliance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A three-stage protective sequence.** **Lexical evidence:** `ع ب د B003` is worship through submissive obedience, `و ق ي B002` is placing the self in protective caution, and `ط و ع B001` is pliant obedience. **Structural cue:** the imperatives proceed from orientation, to guarding, to responsive action; 71:4 then states forgiveness and delay. **Assigned role:** worship sets allegiance, caution creates a barrier against harm, and obedience operationalizes it. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies the order; I infer that each command enables the next. **Reading change:** the verse reads as a compact safety mechanism rather than three interchangeable pieties.

2. **Pliancy versus self-enlargement.** **Lexical evidence:** `ط و ع B001` anchors `أَطِيعُونِ`, while `ك ب ر B006` at 71:7 marks self-magnification and refusal to submit to truth. **Structural cue:** the requested yielding is later reversed by bodily closure, insistence, and emphatic pride. **Assigned role:** obedience is the flexible posture that keeps the warning channel open. **Abductive move:** I infer from the antithetical sequence that pride blocks compliance by making the self its own authority. **Reading change:** obedience reads as relinquishing self-rule, not mere execution of an order.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The emphatic self-magnification at 71:7 supplied the exact reversal of `ط و ع B001`: pliancy keeps the warning channel usable, while pride makes bodily closure into self-rule. This made the three imperatives a coordinated posture-change, not merely adjacent duties.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Covering Can Refuse Exposure or Convert It Into Safety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover changes the relation between an exposed subject and what reaches it, either by blocking reception or by shielding from harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same material logic that makes a garment into an acoustic barricade also makes forgiveness a protective cover and a garden a habitable enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pardoning cover interposes a shield against consequence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fault remains real, but a preserving layer covers it and stands between the offender and its damaging return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general covering that preserves (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from the effect of sin (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); offense with a harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); barrier that repels injury (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); restraint and withholding (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); garment as protective covering (`quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forgiveness does not erase the causal scene by denial; it inserts a preserving layer. Shield, garment, restraint, and pardoning cover all modify exposure to harm. This reverses the crowd's operation: they cover themselves from the message, while the offered cover would protect them from the consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: paved and leveled road (`quranic:root_000973:B005/m01`); straightness and sound order (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); sustaining support or framework (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); easy limbs and gentle travel (`quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`); readiness and tractable approach (`quranic:root_000009:B003/m01`); pasture opened for grazing and fruit ready to pick (`quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`); fitness and preparedness (`quranic:root_000434:B005/m01`); acceptance with satisfaction (`quranic:root_001198:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs share a functional invariant: an impediment is removed so that the intended operation can proceed. A road is leveled, limbs travel easily, a field permits grazing, and fruit permits gathering. Obedience is thereby materialized as becoming usable by a good direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Response to command is figured as a change in resistance: yielding makes action smooth and passable, while refusal produces knots, stiffness, and upward competitive pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Obedience is not only a social posture; it is a road made level, a rein made responsive, and fruit made ready to gather.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reverence balances hope, composure, and tested weight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Expectation of divine good settles into deliberate conduct, dignified stillness, and the stable weight of tested character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: heart reaching toward hoped-for good (`quranic:root_000548:B001/m01`); dignity, composure, and reverence (`quranic:root_001674:B003/m01`); character hardened by experience (`quranic:root_001674:B007/m01`); honoring and magnifying rightly (`quranic:root_000973:B006/m01`); measured deliberation (`quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`); elevation and high standing (`quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`); good reputation carried outward (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reverence is neither fear alone nor social inflation. Hope supplies an inward orientation, experience gives weight, deliberation slows conduct, and composure makes honor visible without competitive self-elevation. The scene distinguishes warranted dignity from the swollen rank of refusal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Supply moves through a causal system from elevated release, to capture and routing, to biological and economic increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Rain is rendered not as atmosphere alone but as a complete infrastructure: cloud reservoir, discharge, basin, channel, productive estate, and circulating surplus.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water is converted into garden, offspring, and bodily growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Routed supply enters living substrates, thickens vegetation, produces yield, and sustains human and familial increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense and surging vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); crop and palm yield (`quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`); pasture and fruit ready for use (`quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`); building flesh through food (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); lineage and offspring (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); connected reinforcement by material, wealth, or children (`quranic:root_001407:B002/m01`); making and bringing into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); placing into a new condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); wealth accumulated as property (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The flow becomes productive only when it enters a living system. Yield, ripe pasture, thick vegetation, nourishment building flesh, children extending lineage, and wealth extending capacity are successive conversions of one supply. The surface gifts form an ecology rather than a loose inventory.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective identity depends on a governing relation that gathers and tends members; rejection reverses that gathering into dispersal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The people addressed as a social body are also legible as a tended herd whose keeper supplies pasture, water, and milk, yet whose response is to bolt and fragment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pastoral care releases, waters, and feeds a herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A keeper gathers animals, releases them in ordered groups, provides water and milk, and holds them in usable pasture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wild herd gathered as one (`quranic:root_000016:B004/m01`); stock retained in pasture (`quranic:root_000016:B008/m01`); herd of cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); successive groups sent to pasture or water (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); repeated milk supply (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); residual milk drawing the next flow (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`); watering directly at the animals' mouths (`quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`); pasture opened and fruit made available (`quranic:root_000956:B007/m01`); herd or flock (`quranic:root_001674:B006/m01`); young animal following its dam (`quranic:root_001142:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a husbandry mechanism with keeper, herd, release, feeding ground, water, and milk. It gives the divine provision a pastoral form: restraint is used for care, release is ordered, and recurring nourishment draws more nourishment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective identity depends on a governing relation that gathers and tends members; rejection reverses that gathering into dispersal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The summoned herd breaks formation and scatters
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Instead of inclining toward the caller, members bolt, move erratically, and disperse into incompatible directions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: flight and escape (`quranic:root_001142:B001/m01`); rash, foolish haste (`quranic:root_001142:B005/m01`); violent shaking and tearing motion (`quranic:root_001142:B006/m01`); crowd in confusion (`quranic:root_001142:B016/m01`); people or roads scattered in every direction (`quranic:root_000973:B010/m01`); mount disabled or refusing movement (`quranic:root_000973:B011/m01`); cascading collapse (`quranic:root_000478:B005/m01`); confrontation and resistance (`quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`); immobility and exhaustion (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`); competitive domination (`quranic:root_001281:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Flight is decomposed into escape, rash acceleration, tearing movement, confusion, and scattering. The disabled mount provides the inverse failure, while confrontation gives the social cause. The collective ceases to behave as a gathered people and becomes motion without common direction.

Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal boynun kendi uzunluğunu değil, boyun üzerinde uzunlamasına uzanan insan yapımı damgayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, damganın yalın adını temel alır; damgayı taşıyan deveye ilişkin yapıya bağlı niteleme ayrı bir yüz olarak korunur ve genel bir boyun özelliğine dönüştürülmez.

facets.statement: Damga devenin boynunda ve boyun boyunca uzunlamasına yer alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın hem avuç ya da parmakla vurma eylemini hem de bu vuruşun işitilen sesini kapsar; başka araçlarla vurma anlamı eklenmez.
